selection_rule: Lowest mean MAE with equal weight per validation year and horizon; CAMS candidates are reference only; the test year is excluded
caveats: Design-stage experiments looked at 2025 and 2026 scores for four configurations before this protocol was fixed; the rule itself selects on 2024-2025 only
The weather-forecast archive starts in 2024; earlier training rows use observed weather as a stand-in, never rows that are scored
CAMS back-tests are an upper bound: archived values are near-term forecasts at every lead
Daily AQI is final one day late; no future measurement is used
